lessons.keep: Define one visual unit before expanding it into a complex system.
lessons.avoid: Avoid leaving the final analytic map as an attractive but unactionable cloud.
lessons.open: Identity accuracy, false positives, data provenance, investigator workflow, exact particle motion and all audio delivery remain unverified.
try: Show one Tin conversion event becoming a campaign group, then compare groups using a visible legend.
End a network explanation by selecting one flagged group and showing the evidence and next action.

comparison.story: Explain stolen accounts and coordinated operators. → Introduce the product concept. → Define the basic unit: a session signature. → Explain shared identity and suspicious relationships. → Connect behavior with other evidence. → Expand the model to a whole user population. → Close the explanation.
comparison.motion: The browser panel fades to a point, points multiply into clusters and the map expands to fill the frame. Exact particle paths are unresolved. Sampling scope: 1 fps unless a closer window is recorded.
